title: Investigation into Joo Koon MRT Train Accident
what_it_is: Investigation into Joo Koon MRT Train Accident

sections.label: Collision cause software logic issue
sections.summary: The collision was caused by a software logic issue with the new signalling system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The cause of the collision was a software logic issue with the new signalling system.

sections.label: Train captain manual options
sections.summary: If aware, the second train's captain could have switched to Restricted Manual Mode or used the emergency stop button.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Had they been aware of this, the train captain on the second train could have switched from Automatic to Restricted Manual Mode to drive the train manually or, as a last resort, engaged the emergency stop button to keep the train from moving.

sections.label: Thales rectified signalling system
sections.summary: Thales has rectified the system to address the failure condition that led to the collision.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Thales has since rectified the system to address the failure condition which led to the collision.

sections.label: Separating Tuas West Extension operations
sections.summary: As a precaution, operations on the Tuas West Extension were separated from the rest of the East-West Line.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As an added precautionary measure, we decided to separate the operations on the Tuas West Extension from the rest of the East-West Line.

sections.label: Thales accepted responsibility, systems separated
sections.summary: Thales accepted full responsibility and apologised, the flaw was rectified, and the two systems were separated as a precaution.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Whatever it is, the flaw, Thales has accepted full responsibility and has apologised, and the flaw has been rectified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But as an added precaution, I took a decision: let us not complicate our lives both for the software programmer as well as the operator; just separate the two systems.

sections.label: Separating stretches for commuter safety
sections.summary: The two stretches were separated, with shuttle buses run, to ensure maximum safety for commuters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: In fact, we could have run this complicated, double system on the East-West Line, plus the Tuas West Extension, but I decided "no".

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Let us separate the two stretches; we run shuttle buses and the service is not too highly compromised and this way, we ensure maximum safety for our commuters.

sections.label: Train operator reaction time
sections.summary: The speaker says experts reviewed logs and felt the train operator was not able to react in time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I would not know enough to know what sort of reaction time is reasonable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But based on the logs and review by the experts, they felt that the train operator was just not able to react in time.

sections.label: Train driver response distance
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether the train driver could respond in time, noting 36 metres and 18 kilometre per hour speed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: At that moment, was the train driver able to respond in time?

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Thirty-six metres, yes, it is not a short distance, but the speed was 18 kilometre per hour.

sections.label: Brakes in automatic mode
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Minister to clarify whether drivers must switch to manual mode before braking in automatic mode.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Perhaps the Minister could clarify to the public: when a train is on automatic mode, is each driver required to switch to control manual mode, before he can apply the brakes, or he has access to emergency brakes, even in automatic mode?
